title.en: MALACAÑANG PLACING THE OFFICE ON MUSLIM AFFAIRS UNDER THE OVERSIGHT OF THE OFFICE OF THE PRESIDENT

text.en:
The Office on Muslim Affairs is placed under the oversight of the
Office of the President.

Executive Order No. 697, dated 18 January 2008, is hereby
repealed. All other issuances, rules and regulations or parts thereof which are
inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby repealed or modified
accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 315T day of October
Lord, Two Thousand and Eight.
, in the year of Our
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
PGMA Hologram # 46342
